title: MatAnyone-E: sparse propagation for high-resolution video matting

claims.text: The method uses a low-resolution pass to identify uncertain queries and relevant memory, then restricts expensive high-resolution matching. A distilled lightweight decoder reduces another runtime bottleneck.
The abstract reports compiled inference at 73.07 FPS for 1080p and 28.62 FPS for 4K on one NVIDIA H200. A separate estimated 7.4× speedup is presented under its stated comparison.

limitations: These speeds must retain the H200 and compilation conditions.
The estimated speedup and the separately stated compiled comparison are not interchangeable.
gaps: Performance on a Mac or consumer GPU was not measured.
The video’s visual quality comparison was not reviewed.
